2000CLF / 2000DGLF / 2000TCLF / 2000OLF: Cortech Rock Tray Lid with Cor-Flex
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-2000xfl-flexible-lid-for-rock-trays-with-cor-flex
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/food-service/correctional-food-trays/the-rock-tray-with-cor-flex/
Spec sheet: Rock with Cor-Flex and lids
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Rock Tray Lid with Cor-Flex
Current H1: Cortech Lid for Rock Trays with Flexible Cor-Flex
Subtitle: Pliable Cor-Flex Lid for the Cortech Rock Tray with Cor-Flex, in Four Colors
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 2000CLF, 2000DGLF, 2000TCLF, 2000OLF
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Rock Tray Lid with Cor-Flex covers the Cortech Rock Tray with Cor-Flex (sold separately) for meal delivery in prisons, jails, and other correctional facilities.
The lids are made of the same pliable Cor-Flex material as the tray, made with FDA-approved material, and come in the same four colors.
Fit: Made for the Cortech Rock Tray with Cor-Flex (2000F)
Material: Cor-Flex, made with FDA-approved material
Colors: Brown, Dark Gray, Terracotta, or Orange (custom colors available on request)
Packaging: Sold in cases of 10
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
2000CLF – Brown: Cor-Flex lid
2000DGLF – Dark Gray: Cor-Flex lid
2000TCLF – Terracotta: Cor-Flex lid
2000OLF – Orange: Cor-Flex lid
Installation and Options
No assembly is required.
[H2] Applications
The Cor-Flex lid suits facilities that deliver meals on Rock Trays with Cor-Flex and need covered, stackable trays.
Typical applications include:
Inmate meal service in prisons, jails, and detention centers
Central kitchens that deliver meals to housing units
Juvenile detention and other secure facilities
Explore Anchortex's Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection for more food trays, delivery carts, and food service supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Food Service
Cortech food service products are made for high-volume meal service in correctional facilities, where trays, carts, and dispensers are used and washed every day. Cortech trays and delivery carts are sized to work together.
Cortech food service includes:
Insulated Food Trays: The Rock, Rock 2.0, Rock with Cor-Flex, and X-Tray, with matching lids
Tray Delivery Carts: The insulated Chuckwagon, Chuckwagon Jr., and Chuckwagon Max, and the non-insulated Tray Master
Beverage Service: The BevMax insulated beverage dispenser
Tray Drying: Aluminum meal tray drying racks
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (63 characters): Cortech Rock Insulated Food Tray Lid with Cor-Flex at Anchortex
Meta description (145 characters): Shop the Cortech Rock Tray Lid with Cor-Flex. A pliable Cor-Flex lid for the Cortech Rock Tray with Cor-Flex, sold in cases of 10 in four colors.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Food Service" is a new section for the food service pages (trays, lids, delivery carts, BevMax, and drying racks). It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: I used "Rock Tray Lid with Cor-Flex" to match the tray page. There are four model numbers, so I left them out of the H1.
Fit: your current page says the lid fits "Cortech's flexible Cor-Flex Rock food trays." The Cortech spec sheet lists these lids with the Rock Tray with Cor-Flex and says the Rock 2.0 is not available with Cor-Flex.
Weight and size: the Cortech spec sheet does not give a weight or size for the lids, so I left them out.
Warranty: the Cortech spec sheet gives a 5-year warranty for the tray but does not say whether it covers the lids, so I left the warranty out.
Price: your current page says "Packed 10 per case, must buy in full cases. Price is per piece." Can you check whether your price is per lid or per case?
Variant names: your variants say "Chocolate Brown" (with two spaces after the dash), "Dark Grey," and "Terra Cotta." The Cortech spec sheet says "Brown," "Dark Gray," and "Terra Cotta." Would you like them renamed, for example "2000CLF - Brown"?
Collection link: I linked the Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection, which this product is already in.
Product images: the page has one image, the same photo as the Rock lid page. I did not find a photo of the Cor-Flex lid on the Cortech website.
